QuestInfo.name: A Lost Thank-You
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has something to tell me.
QuestInfo.1: #p402# of #m10003000# said that even though he'd made up with his father, he'd already gotten used to his free life in #m10003000#, so he was hesitant about going back home. In the meantime, he wanted to repay the people who'd helped him back when he first arrived in #m10003000# and had such a rough time of it, so he'd prepared some gifts for them — but he'd gone and lost them in the marshland, and asked me to help him get them back. Let's defeat #b#o29##k in the marshland near #m10003000# and find #b#t4031126##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I found #t4031126# in the marshland and brought it back to #p402#.

0.0: Hm? Why haven't I gone home even though I made up with my father? Well, now that I actually have to think about going back, I've realized living in #m10003000# is better than I thought. A strict father, a peaceful but boring town... compared to that, this city has exactly the kind of freedom I used to dream about! #h0#, you're a resident of this city now too, so you get it, right?
0.1: Yeah, I know. Freedom comes with responsibility. When I first got here, not long after running away, I showed up broke and thought I might actually die out here. But the people of this city taught me how to survive. So I want to learn to live freely on my own, if only for their sake.
0.2: But I guess I still have a long way to go. I went into the marshland to find gifts for the people who'd helped me, wanting to show them how much I've grown, but on the way back some monsters attacked me, and I had no choice but to leave everything behind and run for it. Guess I don't even deserve to go home like this... Yeah... #h0#, could you help me out just one more time?

yes.0: Thank you! The ones who attacked me were #b#o29##k. Please defeat them in the marshland connected to the #m10003000# sewers and get my things back for me. I'm counting on you!

no.0: Yeah. Here I am saying I'll learn to live on my own, and yet I'm relying on someone else again like this. I really can't keep living this way forever, can I.

1.0: You're back! Let's see... yeah, this is definitely the thing I lost. Whew... you didn't happen to look inside, did you?

item.0: I went into the marshland to find gifts for the people who'd helped me, but I got attacked by #b#o29##k and had to leave everything behind and run. I was hoping you could defeat them and get it back for me.
